Costume: Sweep Tosho (Casual Clothes) display
...What, did you come to apologize?

It turned out "Magical Doggo" really was that popular, and I was
only able to find one after contacting stores in the next prefecture.

I said no, didn't I?!
Why don't you get it? If you wanna go back, just go home by yourself!

Because it was sold out everywhere...!
I was sure it'd be impossible to get...

If I turn it into a plushie that understands feelings,
then I can become a great witch just like Grandma!

Way off mark... but still,
Grandma's magic really is amazing...
So that I... can become a witch...

Saying it was "to become a witch" might sound like a stretch,
but I really just wanted to support her toward her dream.
Aargh! What do you mean it's sold out?!
......What's with that face?

Ugh, there's no time to waste dawdling!
Familiar, we're heading to the next store!

Enough already! You need to get
much better at reading my mind too, hmph!

Rejoice, Familiar!
Today, I shall bestow upon you a brand new companion!

It's all your fault anyway, Familiar! If you could just run
as fast as me, we might've bought it before it sold out!

Grrr... W-Well, if you insist!
If you're going that far, I guess I can take care of it!

We searched all over yesterday and found nothing.
You obviously didn't find one either, right?!
That's right! Because Grandma used to have one, too...!

However, the sun had already set long ago.
Running around all day might leave her exhausted for tomorrow.

Even if you hadn't found it, Familiar,
I'm sure I would've tracked it down and bought it myself, you know?

So I'm using "Magical Doggo" as a substitute.
I'll cast a spell on Magical Doggo and—

Because I just found out today! "Heal your soul with its cute eyes:
the mystical plushie Magical Doggo goes on sale today!"

It seemed Sweep Tosho wanted to get her hands on the plushie
in order to take after her beloved grandmother.

There's no use saying things you don't mean.
I cast a spell on him, you see, so he knows what's in your heart.
My Familiar is so weird... You think so too, don't you, Doggo?

T-That's not true at all!
Saying I'm sorry to Daddy is totally, completely wrong...

When I want something, I want it!
It HAS to be "Magical Doggo"!
What do you mean, what—huh...?

Sweep Tosho throwing a tantrum was nothing new,
but her unusually stubborn demeanor caught my attention.

...What's that?
Sweepy actually feels sorry towards Daddy?

Even after you made me go home first,
you really kept searching after that?!
...Huh?

Nuh-uh!
I'm not actually thankful at all, you're totally off mark!
Uuugh... *sniffle*, don't come over here right now...
It's a magical doggo, okay?! I'm definitely getting one, so hurry up!

...I am absolutely, positively going to find it.
Familiar, where's the next shop?!

Why was I standing in front of the station with Sweep Tosho on a day off?
The reason goes back about an hour earlier—

Huh? What are you moping around for?!
I really want it, so I'm not giving up!

They don't have it here either...!
Jeez, stop dragging your feet, Familiar! We're searching until we find one!

Sold out here too?!
Why?! Don't tell me you're hiding it in the back!

Well... I mean, yeah?
It's only natural for a familiar to serve their master, right?

However, even after checking every toy store we could think of,
the "Magical Doggo" plushie was completely sold out everywhere.

Clutching "Magical Doggo" tight despite her grumbling,
Sweep Tosho crawled into bed.

...Hmph, I don't care!
I didn't ask you to do that. You just did it on your own, Familiar!
I handed the promised gift to the stunned Sweep Tosho.
Jeez, I've been looking everywhere for you, Familiar! Come on, you're going shopping with me!

And so, we headed over to the nearest toy store
in search of the plushie, but—
Woof woof!
The next morning, I waited for Sweep Tosho on her way to class and called out to her.
Is this... "Magical Doggo"?! You really found one?!

Your Trainer took great care of you, didn't they?
Make sure you thank them properly later!

I want to have a dog that understands feelings just like Grandma!
But you can't keep pets in the dorms, right?
